title: tococa heterophylla
intro: Tococa heterophylla, commonly known as the Amazonian toothbrush tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. The health benefits of Tococa heterophylla include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve oral health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate saliva production, reduce plaque and gingivitis, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tococa heterophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
